method_semantics: Original baseline adapters, placements, trace partitioning and scheduling. Only passive resource profiling added. SP sums all three subclusters with disjoint GPU labels.
failure_policy: Preserve exceptions and process crashes, stop new dispatch, no automatic retries. Numeric regressions are reported, not filtered.
analysis: Paired seeds 0/1/2 only; no new tuning, no held-out claim. Require exact original end-to-end and per-request parity when historical anchors exist. GPU work is not energy consumption.
